text.body:
[śrī ādyanāthaviracitā]
sarvasaṃvinnadībhedabhinnaviśrāntibhūmaye | namaḥ pramātṛvapuṣe śivacaitanyasindhave ||
akṛtrimāhamāmarśaprakāśaikaghanaḥ śivaḥ | śaktyā vimarśavapuṣā svātmano'nanyarūpayā || 1 || śivādikṣitiparyantaṃ viśvaṃ vapurudañcayan | pañcakṛtyamahānāṭyarasikaḥ krīḍati prabhuḥ || 2 || na pārthyagā(rthakyā)tmavārtā'pi viśvaśaktiśarīrayoḥ | na viśvaviśvavapuṣorbhinnatā kāpi tāttvikī || 3 || bhede sattāsphurattābhyāṃ bhinnaṃ kiṃ nu jagad bhavet | sattāsphurattāsambandhāt sattābhānaṃ tu tatra cet || 4 || asataḥ kiṃ satastābhyāṃ sambandhaḥ so'yamiṣyate | svarūpalābhasulābhaḥ sambandho nahyavastunaḥ || 5 || na labdharūpasambandhastābhyāṃ kiñcidapekṣate | apekṣāyāmavasthānaṃ na syādetasya kiñcana || 6 || svabhāvataḥ sphurattā ca sattā ca na vināśinī | vināśānabhyupagame jaḍatā'pi nivartate || 7 || tato gatyantarābhāvāccideva pariśiṣyate | tataścidaikyaṃ prakṛtaṃ jagato na nivartate || 8 || prakāśādanyatābhāsaḥ svātantryollāsakevalaḥ | paricchinatti kaḥ śaktiṃ śambhorviśvātiśāyinaḥ || 9 || svaprakāśātmakaṃ sarvaṃ tamaḥkevalatāṃ gatam | yacca kiñcijjagatyasmin prakāśānnātiricyate || 10 || vimarśasaraṇīṃ prāptamityeṣā tāttvikī gatiḥ | avadhānaikatānānāṃ matirevātra sākṣiṇī || 11 || kiṃ pramāṇairvarākaistaiścidanuprāṇitātmabhiḥ | nahi vaikartanaṃ jyotirdīpālokamapekṣate || 12 || śaktipātapavitre'smin dhītattve ca parīkṣyatām | ādarśe vimalābhoge nanu sarvaṃ prakāśate || 13 || itthaṃ cidātmakaṃ sarvaṃ ṣaṭtriṃśadbhedamudritam | ādau śuddhātmakaṃ tattvaṃ pañcadhā tamasaḥ param || 14 || śivaḥ śaktiśca sādākhyamīśo vidyeti bhidyate | akṣādiśāntavarṇātmā niraṇāyi śivena tu || 15 || kalāvidye rāgakālau niyatirbandha ucyate | māyāpūrvovakārādiyakārāntākṣarātmakaḥ || 16 || pumān śaktirmano buddhirahaṅkṛnmādipañcakam | śrotrādipañcakaṃ nādi ṇādi vāgādipañcakam || 17 || tanmātrapañcakaṃ ñādi ṅādi vyomādipañcakam | sisṛkṣoḥ prathamaspandaḥ śivatattvaṃ prabhoḥ smṛtam || 18 || icchaivā'sya parimlānā śaktitattvamiti smṛtam | svecchayā racitaṃ viśvamācchādyā'hantayā sthitam || 19 || tadeva tattvaṃ sādākhyaṃ sarvānugrahaṇonmukham | tadeveśvaratattvaṃ syāt paśyad viśvamidantayā || 20 || ahantedantayoraikyamitirvidyā nigadyate | svāṅgakalpeṣu bhāveṣu māyātattvaṃ vibhedadhīḥ || 21 || māyāgṛhītasaṃkocaḥ śivaḥ puṃstattvamucyate | ayameva hi saṃsārī jīvo bhokteti gadyate || 22 || jñatva(-)kartṛtva(-)pūrṇatva(-)nityatvādyāśca śaktayaḥ | tatsaṃkocāt saṃkucitāḥ kalādyātmatayā matāḥ || 23 || māyātmanaḥ kalā nāma kiñcitkartṛtvakāraṇam | vidyā kiñcijjñatāhetū rāgo'bhiṣvaṅgakāraṇam || 24 || kālaḥ pariccheda karo niyatiścedameva me | kartavyaṃ nānyadityeṣā vyavasthā yantraṇākṛtiḥ || 25 || prakṛtirguṇasāmyaṃ syādahaṅkārādijanmabhūḥ | ahaṃ mamedamityetadbuddhiheturahaṅkṛtiḥ || 26 || buddhiradhyavasāyasya kāraṇaṃ niścayātmanaḥ | saṃkalpasya vikalpasya bījaṃ mana udīryate || 27 || vacanādeśca śabdādervāgādiśravaṇādikam | kāraṇaṃ śravaṇādīnāṃ grāhyaṃ tanmātrapañcakam || 28 || prakāśādyavakāśādikāraṇaṃ bhūtapañcakam | parāparāśaktimayaṃ śuddhavidyādipañcakam || 29 || tadanyadaparā śaktirityetat tattvamīritam | iyaṃ devī parā śaktiḥ śuddhāśuddhādhvagarbhiṇī || 30 || pṛthivyādīni tattvāni yadā līnāni kāraṇe | tadā kāraṇamātrāṇi bahirudvamate vibhuḥ || 31 || anuttarecche unmeṣa ānandeśanamūnatā | kriyecchājñānaśaktīnāṃ sattā cocchūnatā ca ṣaṭ || 32 || iccheśanāntarārūḍhāḥ sphuṭāsphuṭajaganmayāḥ | catvāraḥ parato varṇāḥ ṣaṇḍhātmānaḥ pracoditāḥ || 33 || anuttarānandacitī icchāśakti niyojite | trikoṇamatha ṣaṭkoṇamicchāyāṃ rūḍhimāgate || 34 || anuttarānandaśaktitrikoṇadvitvayogataḥ | tathaivonmeṣayogena kriyāśakteḥ sphuṭaṃ vapuḥ || 35 || ukta triśaktisaṃghaṭṭa triśūlaṃ dvaitaghasmaram | parasparā virodhena kāryeṣu prasare gate || 36 || na kathañcidupādeyamāsāṃ rūpamidaṃ bhavet | bindurvedyasya saṃskāro vimarśaḥ sarga ityasau || 37 || kalāṣoḍaśakākārā śaktirviyate parā | tithayaḥ pratipatpūrvāḥ pañcadaśyantimā yathā || 38 || sūryācandramasorantaścaratni sthitihetavaḥ | tathā vimarśavapuṣaḥ sargasyādyāḥ kalāḥ smṛtāḥ || 39 || dvidheyaṃ mātṛkā devī bījayonyātmanā sthitā | nityapravṛttā śṛṅgāṭavapurviśvasya janmabhūḥ || 40 || hṛdayaṃ bījametasyāṃ sāraṃ yattatparaṃ mahaḥ | baṭabīje yathā vṛkṣastathātra nihitaṃ jagat || 41 || vicāryamāṇe naivedaṃ kāraṇādatiricyate | mṛdādeḥ kalaśādīnāṃ tattvaṃ nānyannirūpaṇe || 42 || ityāhustattvavādinyaḥ śrutīnāmantimā giraḥ | iha sarvaṃ sadevāgra āsīditi viniścayāt || 43 || sattāvācini bīje'smin bhāti māyāntimaṃ jagat | viluptapratyayākāramevaitat pariśiṣyate || 44 || tato jñānakriyāsārā vidyeśvarasadāśivāḥ | śaktiśūle vilīyante caturdaśakalātmani || 45 || ūrdhvādhaḥ sṛṣṭivapuṣi sarvaṃ līnamataḥ param | itthaṃ parasyāṃ saṃvittau sarvaṃ saṃkucitaṃ kramāt || 46 || atha vāṅmanasātīte yatra kvāpi nirañjane | ṣaṭtriṃśattattvalaharīkalahātītagocare || viśvātmani mahāmantrasvabhāve sā vilīyate || 47 ||
śuddhavidyādikaṃ sarvaṃ sādākhye pakṣasaṃgrahāt || madhyaśaktiparāmarśa iti vāpi layakramaḥ | anyaḥ pakṣo'pi yaḥ kaścit pramāṇaṃ cennabādhate ||
kutaścinmathite dhāmni dīpte kenāpi hetunā | sarvaṃ haviridaṃ juhvanna dāridryeṇa pīḍyate || 48 || pañcapañcātmakaṃ viśvaṃ pañcaspandavijṛmbhitam | saṃkocayan parāmarśāt sāmānyaspandakevalaḥ || 49 || ahami pralayaṃ kurvannidamaḥ pratiyoginaḥ | parākramaparo bhuṅkte svabhāvamaśivāpaham || 50 ||
iti ṣaḍadhikatriṃśadbheda prasaktajagattanuḥ prasarati mahāśaktyullekhavicitramahāpaṭī | jayati bahuśaḥ spandākārā parā cidanuttarā vimṛśata janāḥ kiṃ no bhūyaḥ svabhāvavijṛmbhitam || 51 ||
[iti śrīmadādyanāthaviracitā anuttaraprakāśapañcāśikā
samāptā] ||
